name: Site Memory / Design DNA
runtime_tests: Build Home with a distinct brand/theme, then create About and verify visual DNA carries over.
Make only one card square; verify later pages do not inherit square cards globally.
Ask to make all cards square, confirm, execute, then create another page; verify global card treatment is inherited.
Trigger a failed rebrand request and verify stored Site DNA remains unchanged.
Perform a partial multi-operation global change and verify only verified global values become durable memory.
Explicitly request a new website-wide brand and verify new verified DNA replaces the old one.
